Nina CS: Starting dedicated bring-up for Solstice. Objective: quota gating + safe ramp to 50% reserved QPS. Omar, confirm reserved nodes?

Omar Infra: Confirmed cluster solstice-dedicated (4x A100, 1 warm spare). Labels and taints applied.

Priya SRE: Autoscale policy applied: min=1 max=8 target_queue=150 cooldown=90s. PD alert for p95>360ms.

Leo ML: Priming pushed: short prefix pass then KV-fill. Monitoring KV hit-rate.

Jules SE: Doing a quick smoke now: `loadgen --url https://solstice.redwood/gen --qps 25 --dur 5m`. Posting logs.

warmup-bot: priming job solstice-prime-2026-03-21 started (id: p-5512).

Priya SRE: Smoke ok: median=130ms p95=290ms. Starting ramp plan: 10% -> 25% -> 40% -> 50% (20m soak). Abort if p95>380ms or errors>1%.

Leo ML: KV hit-rate 72% after priming. Will run top-100 prompt pass if no improvement in 15m.

Omar Infra: Added traffic-shed rule to divert to fallback if GPU util >90% or queue>700.

warmup-bot: soak job solstice-soak-2026-03-21 queued (id: s-7710).

Priya SRE: At 50% steady for 12m: p95 ~330ms, errors 0.1%. Holding.

Nina CS: Notifying customer SRE/PM. If stable, we'll mark `onboard: ready` and schedule KT. Will follow up with one-pager.

warmup-bot: soak job s-7710 completed. duration 58m. status: success.

Nina CS: Closing thread — thanks team.
